rationale: The bid-ask spread of 449 bps makes any intraday trade extremely costly to enter and exit, effectively requiring a large move just to break even. The stock has gapped down sharply (-2.70%) and is trading near session lows with only 56K shares of volume and a 5-minute ATR of $0.51 that is inconsistent with the wide spread, indicating poor liquidity conditions. With two working orders already consuming buying power and no clear structural edge that overcomes the transaction cost hurdle, skipping is the appropriate response.
